name: WC AI Summarizer
author: Praveen Kumar

sections.description:
WC AI Summarizer is a free WordPress plugin developed by Wild Creek Web Studio. It lets readers request a summary of a published public post in ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini or Microsoft Copilot. Choose which services to show, write your own prompt and put the links above or below the post. You can also position them with a shortcode or hide them on individual posts.

Under Floating Summarize button, enable mobile, desktop or both to give readers a shortcut when the inline buttons are out of view. The shortcut opens the enabled services and includes manual prompt copying when Gemini or Copilot is enabled.

The default prompt includes the post permalink. Use {post_url}, {post_title} and {site_name} to customise the prompt. The selected provider generates the summary and may require the reader to sign in. A provider may be unable to fetch a page or may change how its link handles prompts.

Learn more on the WC AI Summarizer plugin page.

External services

Microsoft Copilot is optional and off by default. It opens in a new tab and receives the prompt when the reader pastes it there. The reader can copy the prompt manually if clipboard access fails. Enable Show provider icons in Settings to display bundled icons beside the enabled providers.

  • Microsoft Copilot (Terms, Privacy)

ChatGPT, Claude and Grok receive the configured prompt in the destination URL when a reader follows their link. Gemini and Copilot open in a new tab and receive the prompt only when the reader pastes or enters it there. If clipboard access fails, the reader can copy from the manual prompt field. Depending on the template, the prompt can include the post permalink, title or site name.

The plugin uses no server-side AI requests, requires no API key, and does not send the article body. The provider processes the data it receives under its own terms and privacy policy.

  • ChatGPT (Terms, Privacy)
  • Claude (Terms, Privacy)
  • Grok (Terms, Privacy)
  • Gemini (Terms, Privacy)
sections.installation:
Requires WordPress 7.1 or later and PHP 8.3 or later. Tested with PHP 8.4.

  1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin, or upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate WC AI Summarizer from Plugins.
  3. Open Settings > WC AI Summarizer to select services and placement.
  4. For manual placement, add [wc_ai_summarizer] to a Shortcode block in a published public post.
sections.faq:
Where are the links displayed?

On published public posts. Pages, archives, previews, password-protected posts and posts excluded in the editor do not show the links.

Why are Gemini and Copilot asking me to paste a prompt?

Gemini and Copilot open separately. The plugin attempts to copy the prompt on click. If automatic copy is unavailable, return to the post and use the manual prompt field.

Does deleting the plugin remove its settings?

WordPress removes the plugin files. Saved settings and per-post exclusions remain in the database.
